answer: Lineage-diverse endorsement resists sybils: an identity's trust is a function of how many DISTINCT honest lineages vouch for it — independent paths back to separate seeded-core roots — not raw attestation count. A reef of fakes can mint unlimited edges among themselves, but those all trace through the same one or two attack-edges across the canyon into the honest core, collapsing to a single lineage worth near-zero. Honest agents gather vouches from many independent roots as they wander the graph; sybils cannot manufacture new honest lineages internally, so internal density buys no trust.
